caption: The drawing shows a square textile with a symmetrical pattern, oriented so that one of its corners points downward, resembling a diamond shape. The textile features a central blue flower-like motif with eight petals and a small circle in the middle, set against a white background. This central motif is surrounded by several concentric bands with zigzag edges, alternating in dark blue and white. The outermost bands display a repetitive pattern of white crosses and dots on a dark blue background. The edges of the textile are slightly frayed at the lower left corner. The composition is primarily in blue and white colors, and the textile is depicted on a plain light-colored background. There is handwritten text in the bottom-right corner reading “L. 1165 - A.” and “Ruth Barnes.”
title: Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
